title: YURI SDS Plus Drill Bit for Concrete, 6mm Diameter, 110mm Length, 50mm Working Length, Compatible with AEG, Bosch, Hilti, Metabo
description: The YURI 6mm SDS Plus Drill Bit is a reliable and robust tool designed for drilling into concrete, masonry, and other hard surfaces with precision and ease. With a total length of 110mm and a working length of 50mm, this drill bit is perfectly sized for a wide range of drilling tasks, from installing wall anchors to running cables through concrete walls. The 6mm diameter ensures clean, accurate holes every time. Manufactured to ISO 9001 quality standards, this drill bit is built to deliver consistent performance and long-lasting durability. It features an SDS Plus shank, making it compatible with popular power tool brands such as AEG, Bosch, Hilti, and Metabo. The spiral flute design efficiently removes debris from the hole as you drill, reducing heat build-up and improving overall drilling speed. Whether you are a professional tradesperson or a dedicated DIY enthusiast, the YURI 6mm Drill Bit is an essential addition to your toolkit for tackling tough drilling jobs with confidence.
